summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for her second cycle of R-ICE chemotherapy with added rituximab due to EBV viremia in the context of classical Hodgkin lymphoma and common variable immunodeficiency. She had ongoing neck pain and a history of intracranial involvement from lymphoma. Imaging showed response to prior treatment with decreased nasopharyngeal mass size. A lumbar MRI ruled out spinal involvement. She received intrathecal methotrexate for CNS prophylaxis and completed chemotherapy without complications. Her blood counts remained low but stable, requiring monitoring, and her diabetes was managed with insulin during the admission. She was discharged home with filgrastim to support white blood cell recovery and instructions to continue all home medications, including immunoprophylaxis and pain management.
